title: jmap-chat-mimi draft: cite message-status-02 and map every status
description: From assay mimid-1wgh.44.11. ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec/draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00.md L76-83 cites draft-mahy-mimi-message-status-01 with 'Work in progress; this individual draft expired on 2026-09-03.' -02 was posted 2026-11-01 and is active (expires 2027-05-05): update the reference and drop the 'expired' note. §Message Status (L147-149) says only that expired, hidden and error are not read acknowledgements; it does not say how delivered (1), read (2), unread (0) and deleted (4) map to JMAP (readAt, ReadPosition, deletedAt), or which direction converts. Our draft; editing it is in scope for the draft work (commit with a hackathon note only if Mark wants it in that batch).
